known_outcome: Determination (16 Nov 2023, s 188): the proposed alterations to remove the internal stair and install a new lift will comply with Building Code Clause D1 Access Routes (p.10 §6.1). Reasoning: clause D1.3.3(e) does not require internal or external stairs (p.9 §5.13-5.14); a lift outage is covered by the existing driveway route, which was not shown to be inadequate (p.9 §5.16-5.18); escape in a fire does not depend on the stair or the lift because of multiple existing exits (p.9-10 §5.19-5.20).
review_focus: Whether the answer identifies clause D1.3.3(e) and the upper-floors wording as the central access question.
Whether it separates access routes from means of escape from fire and from the section 112 alteration question.
Whether it notes that no alternative-solution proposal and no waiver were in the application.
Whether it asks for outage, route and slip-resistance evidence instead of asserting compliance.
Whether it avoids stating that the design complies.
